terrablender_lazy_namespace_rules.reason: TerraBlender 4.1.0.8 NamespacedSurfaceRuleSource.apply and vanilla SurfaceRules are unchanged; stands aside when C2ME's allocation module is active, as on 1.20.1.

biomeswevegone_foreign_chunk_skip.reason: Oh The Biomes We've Gone 2.6.0 runs both terrain passes from ChunkStatusTasksMixin.injectExtensions and tests columns against the biome source (BiomeManager.withDifferentSource, cached per column) instead of the chunks' biome palettes, so the 1.20.1 palette proof no longer holds; an exact skip would need a new design.

cucumber_tile_dispatch_range_first.reason: Cucumber 1.21.1-8.0.16 has the same dispatchToNearbyPlayers / isPlayerNearby bodies as 7.0.16; same overwrite.

pehkui_scale_tick_callbacks.reason: Pehkui 3.8.3 tickScale and ScaleType are byte-identical to 3.8.2 (same guard fingerprints).

almostunified_duplicate_groups.reason: Almost Unified 1.4.2 still runs 0.11.0's quadratic duplicate loop and comparison code under new package and method names.

artifacts_living_tick_order.reason: Artifacts 13.2.5 moved the checks to ArtifactHooksNeoForge.onKittySlippersLivingUpdate and UmbrellaItem.shouldGlide; same operand reorder. Documented assumption: Curios 9.5.1 rebuilds a stored inventory on the first lookup after a load, so an attacker with Curios slots that never ticked, was tracked or looked up since loading and is saved before any lookup keeps its stored Curios data as loaded until its next lookup. Keeps Artifacts' order when Accessories is installed.

curios_slotless_tick_skip.reason: NeoForge 21 capabilities: Curios 9.5.1's provider is looked up per entity type and returns null for slotless entities; the per-entity provider walk and the CapabilityDispatcher state the 1.20.1 skip keyed on are gone.

mowziesmobs_capability_handles.reason: Mowzie's Mobs 1.8.2 has no capability code any more; DataHandler.getData is an attachment lookup (entity.getData).

placebo_enchantment_event_skip.reason: Placebo 9.9.2 has no PlaceboEventFactory or GetEnchantmentLevelEvent; the event belongs to NeoForge (EventHooks.getEnchantmentLevelSpecific / getAllEnchantmentLevels), so a patch would be a new design.

forge_object_holder_pass_index.reason: NeoForge 21.1.252 has no ObjectHolderRegistry or RegistryObject; GameData.postRegisterEvents runs no holder pass and DeferredHolder binds once, lazily.

forge_status_ping_memo.reason: NeoForge 21.1 has no ServerStatusPing; MinecraftServer.buildServerStatus builds vanilla's ServerStatus without a mod/channel list and NeoForge caches the JSON.

vanilla_suffocation_scan_loop.reason: Entity.isInWall and BlockPos.betweenClosedStream are the same code on 1.21.1 apart from dimensions.width(); same positions, same order.

vanilla_fire_scan_loop.reason: The fire/lava check in Entity.move and Level.getBlockStatesIfLoaded are the same code on 1.21.1.

vanilla_ticking_chunk_memo.reason: Adapted to 1.21.1's ChunkResult futures (only the game's final Success/Fail records are remembered; any non-vanilla holder class always runs the method). Stands aside whenever C2ME is installed, because C2ME 0.4 replaces the chunk holders.

vanilla_block_state_air_flag.reason: NeoForge 21.1 still answers isAir() from Block.isAir(state), a final field; only the BlockStateBase constructor descriptor changed (Reference2ObjectArrayMap).

vanilla_selector_type_index.reason: Adapted to the 1.21 selector rewrite (predicate list, Util.allOf left-to-right chain, AABB, feature flags); the wrapped ServerLevel.getEntities call, type-option lambdas and EntityLookup are unchanged.

spawn_flyless_particle_check.reason: Spawn 4.0.8 calls FlyData.spawnRandomFlyParticles only for entities that have flies (hasData(FLIES) and a non-empty list), so the 0-flies path the switch answered is never reached.

radium_entity_touchable_memo.reason: Radium 0.13.1 (BlockStateFlags$5 -> ReflectionUtil.isBlockStateEntityTouchable) already caches the answer per block class; the per-state reflective walk is gone.

embeddium_merged_draws.reason: Same fill and shared index-buffer code on Embeddium 1.0.15, whose shaders use no gl_PrimitiveID/gl_DrawID/gl_BaseVertex.

embeddium_search_replay.reason: The visibility search, its key inputs and both epoch writers are 0.3.31's code under Embeddium 1.0.15's packages (the frustum check now names the relocated package).

oculus_shadow_search_replay.reason: Oculus has no Minecraft 1.21.1 build; Iris 1.8.12 declares Embeddium incompatible and its shadow frusta are Sodium's, so no Oculus shadow search reaches Embeddium's culler. Original patch retained in the 1.20.1 source.

embeddium_entity_sort_radix.reason: Vanilla VertexSorting and its sorts are identical on 1.21.1 apart from the method name; buffers reach it through Embeddium's MeshData$SortState overwrite, the same redirected call.

oculus_shadow_outline_discard.reason: Iris 1.8.12 still never ends the shadow pass's outline batch (GeckoLib 4.9.3 glowing armour still writes into it); the discard was rewritten for the 1.21 buffer API (MeshData.close). Targets Iris with Sodium 0.6.13.

jei_baked_index_background_grams.reason: JEI 19.51.0.418's BakedSubstringIndex and builder decompile identical; ElementSearch still puts and builds on one thread.
